name: UnysonPlus-AI-Dev-Kit
description: Version marker for the AI Dev Kit. Bump kit_version (+0.0.1, cap/cascade at 99) whenever a bundled component below changes, and update its recorded version, so the kit recognizes it carries an update. assemble.ps1 refreshes the bundled folders from these sources.
bump_rule: When the capture service OR the Site Converter extension (or any bundled component) is updated, bump kit_version and set the matching entry under "bundled" to the new version.
